info.name:
Cancel an active ChatKit session and return its most recent metadata.

Cancelling prevents new requests from using the issued client secret.

params.name: session_id
params.description: Unique identifier for the ChatKit session to cancel.

info.name: List items that belong to a ChatKit thread.

params.name: thread_id
params.description: Identifier of the ChatKit thread whose items are requested.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of thread items to return. Defaults to 20.

params.name: order
params.description: Sort order for results by creation time. Defaults to `desc`.

params.name: after
params.description: List items created after this thread item ID. Defaults to null for the first page.

params.name: before
params.description: List items created before this thread item ID. Defaults to null for the newest results.

items.docs: List items that belong to a ChatKit thread.

info.name: List ChatKit threads with optional pagination and user filters.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of thread items to return. Defaults to 20.

params.name: order
params.description: Sort order for results by creation time. Defaults to `desc`.

params.name: after
params.description: List items created after this thread item ID. Defaults to null for the first page.

params.name: before
params.description: List items created before this thread item ID. Defaults to null for the newest results.

params.name: user
params.description: Filter threads that belong to this user identifier. Defaults to null to return all users.

items.docs: List ChatKit threads with optional pagination and user filters.
